description: This PHP source file defines a database migration class for version 4.1.1 of the OrangeHRM application. It contains logic to modify the database schema related to the 'hs_hr_emp_member_detail' table, including dropping foreign keys and primary keys, adding an 'id' column, setting it as the primary key, and enabling constraints.
